LidarScan · Redesign Proposal

The instrument, refined

Same ember-and-scan identity, evolved: a floating capsule tab bar for one-handed field work, the live view promoted to a full hero, project cards that show the scan itself, and a desktop that gives the viewport almost the whole window. Rendered from the editable Pencil design — not sketches.

What changed

Capsule tab barProjects · Capture · Jobs · Settings — thumb-reachable top-level nav replaces drill-in-only flow.
New type systemSpace Grotesk display · Inter UI · JetBrains Mono telemetry.
Live view as hero~70% of the capture screen is viewport; 3D/AR control and SLAM chip float on the view.
Scans, not filenamesEvery project card carries its own mini point-cloud with the ember trajectory.
Desktop icon rail + glass inspectorThe wide sidebar and fixed docks give way to a slim rail and one floating panel.
